title: Check the voltages match
text: The panel's open-circuit voltage must be below the device's highest solar input voltage.
image_alt: A label with a line marked Voc.

title: A panel is live in the light
text: Cover the panel with an opaque sheet before you touch a lead, and check with a meter that the leads read zero volts.

title: If a lead or the panel gets hot
text: If a lead or the panel is hot, smells of burning or gives off smoke, step away and call the site supervisor at once.

title: Web only
text: Cover the panel before touching a lead.
